[[File:TIEfighter-Fathead.png|thumb|right|250px|A TIE fighter reinforced with titanium]]
'''Titanium''' was a metallic element. It was valued for its strength and low density.

Fighters of the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] had hulls reinforced with titanium. A titanium alloy was also used in the construction of hulls for [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]]. [[Flirt]] was composed of a titanium shell.

Double doors at an [[Imperial research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] had a titanium bar on them. However, it was bent by one or more of the mad [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] there and thus failed to contain them.

The [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] of the [[Command Base]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Roche asteroid field]] were constructed of enhanced titanium.<ref name="SFS">''[[Strike Force: Shantipole]]''</ref>
